text:
Maya: Thanks for the all-hands recap — posting a short live thread to capture outstanding Qs on the outage RCA and assign owners. RCA link: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-04 :point_right: please drop any follow-ups here.

Jon: Saw the RCA, great writeup. Quick Q — who owns the client retry/backoff change mentioned in the mitigation section? Leadership said infra but no owner named.

Maya: Good catch. Tagging @Lucas to confirm ownership of the backoff change.

Lucas: I can take that. Will own changing default SDK retry to exp backoff + jitter and land a config flag for customers. Schedule: design doc by tomorrow, PR by Wed EOD.

Priya: Will that change affect latency tails for short requests? we should validate in staging.

Lucas: We'll run perf tests and a canary on a small Dedicated pool before wide rollout. Expect negligible tail increase; adding jitter helps smooth spikes.

Anita: Can we add a short checklist for rollout and alerts? Suggest: 1) canary 2) monitoring 3) rollback plan.

ops-oncall: I'll add a Grafana alert for increased 5xx and router latency post-deploy. Creating alert now — link: https://grafana.redwood/alert/1234

Jon: Thanks — also asking about the KV cache invalidation note. Who's owning that follow-up?

Maya: @Priya can you pick up the cache invalidation investigation? It was mentioned as a potential root cause for some sessions.

Priya: I can. Plan: reproduce with sim tests, check TTLs and prefix collisions, propose fix by next Tue. Will post findings in the ticket.

Maya: Great. Can we capture actionables clearly here so folks can triage?

Maya: Action items (short):
```
- Lucas: Implement SDK backoff + jitter, design doc by T+1 day, PR Wed EOD.
- Priya: Investigate KV cache invalidation, sim tests + proposal by next Tue.
- ops-oncall: Add Grafana alert for 5xx/latency (https://grafana.redwood/alert/1234) ASAP.
- Maya: Coordinate rollout plan and schedule canary window, post canary playbook in #eng-sre.
```

Lucas: I'll link the draft PR here when ready.

Priya: I'll create a tickets/board card and link it to the RCA doc.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If any leadership follow-ups from the all-hands require prioritization bumps, tag me and I'll escalate.

incident-bot: INC-2026-04 RCA published by Maya (link: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-04). PDF snapshot available in /shared/rcas/.

Jon: One last ask from the Q&A — can we include a short blurb in next week's status email explaining the customer impact window + mitigations? I'll draft and push to comms.

Maya: Perfect — thanks Jon. Closing thread when all owners confirm PR/alert links. :white_check_mark:
